'''2007 Australian Championship Chris LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris]] at [[2007 Australian Championship]].

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
